comment: 24yo male, recently confirmed germline SDHC c.214C>T (p.Arg72Cys) pathogenic variant identified via cascade testing after mother diagnosed with bilateral carotid-body paragangliomas at age 38 (treated by hearing-preservation microsurgery on both sides — preserved bilateral useful hearing and intact lower-cranial-nerve function). No personal cancer diagnosis; normal baseline plasma free metanephrines + methoxytyramine (3-MT); no audiologic symptoms; no pulsatile tinnitus; normal cranial-nerve examination; no palpable neck mass. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = SDHC carrier surveillance — head + neck MRI annually starting now (age 24, within 10-15 baseline window — late baseline given proband only just identified) + plasma metanephrines + methoxytyramine q12mo + whole-body MRI q3y + abdominal MRI q2-3y consolidated with whole-body MRI + cascade testing for sister (untested) + dermatology q1-2y for cutaneous schwannomas (additional NF2-spectrum overlap counseling — not applicable for SDHC); alternative = less-intensive symptom-driven track with biochemistry-only surveillance + cross-sectional imaging triggered by audiologic / vestibular / cranial-nerve symptoms (offered given SDHC's ~10-15% lifetime PPGL risk + <5% metastatic rate, but patient declines given mother's bilateral disease — opts for scheduled surveillance).
